description: Tuning of the PC's optional cameras (config.cfg control_style tps = third person, ots = over the shoulder, fps = first person). Distances are metres with +Y pointing down (negative heights are above the floor), angles in degrees unless the key says otherwise, mouse and stick turn rates in Q12 angle units (4096 = a full turn). Player-facing options (sensitivity, zoom, shoulder offsets, wall collision, head tracking, melee swing) stay in config.cfg; this file holds the fixed numbers behind them. Every section and key is checked: an unknown key is an error. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.

orbit.description: Third person and over the shoulder orbit. distance: orbit radius in metres; aim_distance: the radius at the default 100% aim zoom (200% goes as far in again, 2 * aim_distance - distance, which is also the nearest the orbit may come); height / look_at_height / head_height: heights above Harry's feet (negative = up); look_at_distance: how far ahead the aim ray reaches; zoom_percent_limit: highest aim zoom option.

look.description: Look input. mouse_*: Q12 angle units per mouse pixel. stick_dead_zone: dead zone out of 128; stick_*: Q12 angle units per 30 fps frame at full deflection. pitch_min_deg / pitch_max_deg: orbit pitch limits (negative looks up). Third person only: stick_exponent is the response curve past the dead zone (1 = linear); smoothing_time is the look smoothing in seconds at 100% of the tps_look_smoothing option.

first_person.description: First person look limits in degrees: pitch (up/down) and yaw (left/right of Harry's body), and the limit with the head look added (view_pitch_limit_deg). head_follow_shift: the head sway reference low-pass (1/2^n per frame). The head look eases in between head_look_delay_ms and head_look_full_ms after Harry stops moving. sway_limit: the eye follows the head's sway no farther than this from its tuned spot, in metres. sway_time: the picture's eye follows that sway over this smooth time in seconds (0 = at once, in the 4 mm steps the head bone moves by).

melee_swing.description: First person melee camera dolly, distances in metres: it starts when a forearm or hand comes nearer the eye than near, keeps wall metres away from level geometry behind the eye, draws Harry's head beyond head_show and hides it below head_hide, and snaps back home within snap.

walls.description: Third person wall pull-in, in metres: the eye stays margin short of a wall and never closer than min to Harry's head.

spring_arm.description: Third person and over the shoulder camera smoothing. Times are spring smooth times in seconds (critically damped, the same at any frame rate); distances in metres. follow_time: pivot follow at 100% of the tps_camera_smoothing option (50% halves it); vertical follow is follow_vertical_scale times softer and aiming follow is follow_aim_scale times tighter; the pivot never trails Harry by more than max_lag and a jump beyond teleport_distance snaps the camera. zoom_time eases the orbit radius and shoulder offset when aiming in and out. Walls: a cone of five rays from the shoulder point to the eye with probe_radius around it; the eye comes in at once from what stands between Harry and it, over ease_in_time from what only the rays around it touch (a door frame, a post), and goes back out over ease_out_time (a spring: it starts from rest), rises by up to close_lift as it comes in (so Harry's head does not fill the view; a ceiling limits it) and keeps only close_shoulder of the shoulder offset at the closest (so Harry stays in frame). While Harry moves and the view has not been turned for tps_recenter_delay seconds, the pitch levels toward recenter_pitch_deg over recenter_time.
